payload.text: `signed_when_reversed` pins the anti-symmetry of the day-count year fraction: with `DayCount::Act365Fixed`, `year_fraction(basis, 2024-01-01, 2023-01-01)` equals −1.0 (asserted via `assert_close!`, the sanctioned float comparator, never `==`). It guards that a reversed accrual interval yields the exact negative year fraction — the property exotic/vol-time accrual relies on for signed time spans — and that the 2024→2023 span is exactly 365 days over the ACT/365 denominator. Pure test: builds dates and asserts via assert_close!, mutating no external state.
